ground.css:
radial-gradient(42rem 42rem at 84% -8%, rgba(33, 22, 1, 0.85), transparent 60%),
radial-gradient(50rem 38rem at 6% 106%, rgba(27, 18, 48, 0.68), transparent 62%),
linear-gradient(176deg, #0A0F1B 0%, #312920 46%, #0F172A 72%, #0D1323 100%)
ground.note: Derived from the generated palette — no new hues. The wash strength (0.85) is the strongest value at which every text role still meets its contrast target against the worst point the gradient can produce.

category.why: The query ranked "SaaS (General)" as the closest of 161 product types, and its reasoning row matched by exact on "SaaS (General)".

pattern.why: "App Store Style Landing" was the top-ranked landing pattern for this query. Its section order and CTA placement come with it.

evidence.sections: 1. Hero with device mockup, 2. Screenshots carousel, 3. Features with icons, 4. Reviews/ratings, 5. Download CTAs
evidence.cta: Download buttons prominent (App Store + Play Store) throughout

style.why: "SaaS (General)" prioritises Glassmorphism + Flat Design, and "Flat Design" is that style by name. It was taken ahead of the raw search ranking.

evidence.best_for: Web apps, mobile apps, cross-platform, startup MVPs, user-friendly, SaaS, dashboards, corporate

colors.why: The palette is the curated set for "Fintech/Crypto" (Gold trust + purple tech), the top match for this query. The category calls for a "Trust blue + Accent contrast" mood.

typography.decision: IBM Plex Sans / IBM Plex Sans
typography.why: "Financial Trust" was the top-ranked pairing, built for Banks, finance, insurance, investment, fintech, enterprise. The category calls for a "Professional + Hierarchy" tone.

effects.decision: No gradients/shadows, simple hover (color/opacity shift), fast loading, clean transitions (150-200ms ease), minimal icons
effects.why: Taken from the selected style "Flat Design". The style's own effects override the category's generic recommendation ("Subtle hover (200-250ms) + Smooth transitions").

spacing.why: "Flat Design" declares no spacing of its own, so the default 8px-based ramp is used.

components.why: Corner radius comes from "Flat Design" itself (--border-radius: 2px). Transition duration also comes from the style (150-200ms).

antiPatterns.decision: Excessive animation + Dark mode by default
antiPatterns.why: Recorded against "SaaS (General)" as the things that break this product category.
